mapper.select: select wo.id, wo.order_id, wo.user_id, ui.user_name, wo.target_id, wo.target_type, wo.order_type, wo.reason, wo.file_path, wo.status, wo.create_time, wo.update_time, wo.handle_reason from work_order wo inner join user_info ui on wo.user_id = ui.user_id where wo.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY wo.create_time DESC, wo.id DESC
select id, user_account, phone, email, password, status, last_login_time, permission_id, create_time from user where phone = #{phone} and (status = 0 or status = 1)
